decisions.reason: After surviving its first review cycle, this close-to-core upholstery fabric now looks like a low-cost, proven option with enough fit to the established range to justify keeping it on the market.
Its flame-retardant function serves the firm's contract and project-textile strengths, and another year on the market makes it a strategically attractive option to retain.
As a newly launched fabric that extends the core offer across both upholstery and curtains, it is still in the option-evaluation stage and should be kept while market feedback develops.
